LanguageData.MooGirl_Cheongsam.label: Mugirl Cheongsam "Robe de la Lune et des Nuages"
LanguageData.MooGirl_Cheongsam.description: "Vache Rousse" presents a high-slit silk cheongsam, where intricate floral embroidery complements a daringly low neckline.\nA collision of Eastern aesthetics and modern sensuality, transforming the wearer into a moving vision of pure white focus.
LanguageData.MooGirl_Gambeson.label: Mugirl Knightly Gambeson
LanguageData.MooGirl_Gambeson.description: "Vache Rousse" presents a supple padded underlayer tailored with medieval craftsmanship, built from overlapping quilting that sits close to the body without losing its lightness. Made to fit Mugirl armour, it cushions impacts and stabilises the wearer beneath heavy plate, yet can also be worn alone as a light battle garment. Its stitched patterns seem to carry a gentle warmth, allowing elegance to endure even in the cold wind.
LanguageData.MooGirl_Shirt.label: Mugirl Shirt "Lumière Trompeuse Translucide"
LanguageData.MooGirl_Shirt.description: "Vache Rousse" presents a chiffon shirt with a soft lustre and fine striped detailing. Its poised, elegant cut makes it well suited for everyday wear or office settings while preserving a refined sense of fashion.
